annotations.title: Ask to release the approved version on the App Store

description: Asks a person to approve releasing an iOS version App Review approved and that waits for the developer (Pending Developer Release, the release option "manually release"): Apple then puts it on the App Store, for everyone or, with a phased release, to a growing share of people with automatic updates over 7 days. Pass the release of its build (ploa_app_review_status gives it). A version that isn't approved yet, or that Apple releases by itself, is refused with why. Nothing reaches Apple until a person approves on the Ploa dashboard; check it with ploa_approval_status. Needs a token allowed to touch production. Google Play uses ploa_release_promote.

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.
